metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: IMUYEX crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C280 H378 O238 Tb42,42(C4 H10 O1). From the CIF bond table, Tb1 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb2 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb3 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb4 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb5 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb6 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb7 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb8 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb10 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb11 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb12 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb13 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb14 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb15 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb16 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb17 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb18 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb19 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb20 (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb21 (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb1A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb2A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb3A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb4A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb5A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb6A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb7A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb8A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb9A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb10A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb11A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb12A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb13A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb14A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb15A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb16A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb17A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb18A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb19A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors; Tb20A (Tb) has 8 O neighbors; Tb21A (Tb) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 70 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.582-3.987 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 92.99-112.49°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula Tb42L14(OAc)82(OH)30 (L = deprotonated ortho-vanillin). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 82 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 30 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
